Draft/Notes:
Subject: On-call moving to two-week shifts starting the 15th

Team — Starting the 15th, we’re moving on-call from one-week to two-week shifts. This gives better continuity, fewer context switches, and clearer ownership for incidents and follow-ups. Rotation order, escalation paths, and handoff expectations remain the same; please update your calendars—the on-call schedule has been adjusted. For handoffs, include current status, open tickets, and any follow-ups. If you have questions or concerns, reply here or contact [on-call manager/contact]. Thanks for your flexibility.
